title: Alani Bankhead
intro:
Alani Bankhead (Democratic Party) is running for election to the U.S. Senate to represent Montana. She is on the ballot in the general election on November 3, 2026. She advanced from the Democratic primary on June 2, 2026.
Bankhead completed Ballotpedia's Candidate Connection survey in 2026. Click here to read the survey answers.
